purpose: Choose a first dataset inspection route by task and evidence, not by a universal score.
scope: Five deliberately selected starting points, not an exhaustive catalog or an interoperability certification.

records.name: Open X-Embodiment
records.use_when: You need a mixture of robot embodiments and are prepared to define a per-dataset adapter.
records.signals_and_actions: RLDS episodes; cameras, state fields and action conventions vary across constituent datasets. The RT-1-X checkpoint interface is not a schema for every dataset.
records.format: RLDS episodes; download and loading examples in the official repository.
records.first_check: Choose one constituent dataset in the official inventory, inspect an episode with the official notebook, and record its action units and split before mixing it with others.
records.rights: Repository: Apache-2.0 for software; CC BY 4.0 for other repository materials. Inspect the selected constituent dataset's own terms and citation; do not assign one inferred license to the whole mixture.
records.evidence: Source inspection on 2026-10-28. No dataset payload or training run was checked in this review.
records.stop_if: The intended subset has unresolved action semantics, rights, or a held-out evaluation boundary.

sources.label: Official repository at 9eeb68b: access, constituent inventory and licensing

records.name: DROID
records.use_when: You need varied real-world manipulation scenes on a common Franka platform.
records.signals_and_actions: The documented RLDS schema exposes three camera views, observed state and action_dict commands. A pinned policy-loader example constructs a 10-dimensional absolute target from Cartesian position, a 6D rotation representation and gripper position.
records.format: RLDS for training; separate raw high-resolution/stereo files. The documentation advertises a 100-episode RLDS debugging subset (~2 GB).
records.first_check: Start with the official visualizer or 100-episode subset, then trace the exact loader's command representation and camera selection. The subset size is provider-reported, not a download measured by RoboSkin.
records.rights: The v2 paper states CC BY 4.0 for the dataset. Keep dataset rights separate from the software license and any later annotation release.
records.evidence: Documentation, v2 paper and pinned loader source inspected on 2026-10-28. The DROID loader was not executed and no DROID episode was downloaded in this review.
records.stop_if: A seven-number array is being treated as seven joint targets without tracing the producing transform and controller.

sources.label: DROID paper v2: platform and dataset license
Pinned loader: absolute targets, camera selection and filters

records.name: BridgeData V2
records.use_when: You need goal- or language-conditioned manipulation examples on the WidowX platform.
records.signals_and_actions: Robot observations, states, actions and language; camera/depth coverage varies. Teleoperated demonstrations and scripted pick-and-place rollouts are separate collections.
records.format: Raw JPEG/PNG/pickle files; processed 256 × 256 TFDS/RLDS option. A file container is not an action-unit specification.
records.first_check: Choose demonstrations or scripted rollouts deliberately, inspect the available camera views, then pin the conversion and loader used for the training target.
records.rights: The official project states CC BY 4.0 for all data. The training repository's software terms are separate.
records.evidence: Official project and pinned training README inspected on 2026-10-28. No raw archive, converter or policy was run in this review.
records.stop_if: You need a tactile stream or all four camera views and have not confirmed them in the chosen episodes.

sources.label: Official composition, hardware, camera coverage and data license

records.name: LeRobot koch_pick_place_1_lego example
records.use_when: You need a bounded exercise to inspect LeRobot v3 storage and loader behavior before choosing training data.
records.signals_and_actions: Two camera streams; six-element state and action vectors. The pinned metadata declares robot_type unknown and does not establish physical units. No tactile feature is declared.
records.format: LeRobot v3 Parquet and MP4 shards with episode metadata.
records.first_check: Use RoboSkin's existing episode-0 exercise: 445 rows, two decoded video streams and five complete official-loader samples. Read the dated report and its limits.
records.rights: The pinned dataset card declares Apache-2.0. It does not supply a complete robot/controller contract.
records.evidence: Pinned card re-read on 2026-10-28; file/loader results are the separate recorded RoboSkin run of 2026-10-25, not a new run today.
records.stop_if: The repository name is being used to infer verified robot identity, units, calibration or suitability for another policy.

sources.label: RoboSkin's dated loader exercise and limits

records.name: UniVTAC / Tactile-ETA Lift Bottle inputs
records.use_when: You need a public simulated example of action-aligned camera and bilateral tactile context.
records.signals_and_actions: Head/wrist RGB, bilateral marker RGB, measured end-effector/joint state and simulation steps. The released demonstration describes measured motion; original actuator/tool commands are not available in that package.
records.format: Pinned HDF5 episodes plus Tactile-ETA JSON and PNG strips.
records.first_check: Run the accompanying offline audit of upstream episodes 0 and 1. It checks 24 segments and released strip pixels against the raw data, without policy inference.
records.rights: The pinned UniVTAC dataset card declares MIT; Tactile-ETA's demonstration README attributes these processed inputs to that release. Review separately any simulator, model or task-asset terms.
records.evidence: Actual local input audit on 2026-10-28. This does not reproduce a success rate, run a selector's feature computation, or test a physical robot.
records.stop_if: You need measured physical contact, original commanded actions or an independently reproduced control result.

sources.label: Pinned preparation code: measured motion and nominal timing
